mapper.select: select t1.applet_date, t1.user_type, t1.valid_start_date, t1.valid_end_date, t1.create_time, t1.update_time from (select user_type, max(applet_date) as applet_date, max(create_time) as create_time, max(update_time) as update_time from b_marketing_data_valid_config where api_code = '${apiCode}' and is_del = 1 and valid_type = 1 group by user_type) t2 left join b_marketing_data_valid_config t1 on t2.user_type = t1.user_type and t2.applet_date = t1.applet_date and t2.update_time = t1.update_time and t1.create_time = t2.create_time where t1.is_del = 1 and t1.valid_type = 1

select t2.id as id, t1.applet_date as appletDate, t1.user_type as userType, t1.valid_start_date as validStartDate, t1.valid_end_date as validEndDate, t1.create_time as createTime, t1.update_time as updateTime from (select id from b_marketing_data_valid_config where api_code = '${apiCode}' and is_del = 1 and valid_type = 1
and user_type='${userType}'
and user_type in
'${userType}'
and valid_start_date <= '${dateStr}' and valid_end_date >= '${dateStr}'
order by applet_date, update_time, create_time
limit ${page * pageSize},${pageSize}
) t2 left join b_marketing_data_valid_config t1 on t2.id = t1.id order by applet_date, update_time, create_time

select MIN(valid_start_date) as validStartDate, MAX(valid_end_date) as validEndDate from b_marketing_data_valid_config where api_code = '${apiCode}'
and is_del = 1
and valid_type = 1
and user_type in
'${userType}'
and valid_start_date <= '${dateStr}' and valid_end_date >= '${dateStr}';

SELECT api_code as apiCode, min(valid_start_date) as validStartDate, max(valid_end_date) as validEndDate FROM b_marketing_data_valid_config WHERE is_del = 1 AND valid_type = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d') between valid_start_date and valid_end_date AND (user_type, api_code) IN (SELECT user_type , api_code FROM b_marketing_data_valid_config WHERE id = #{id});

SELECT api_code as apiCode, min(valid_start_date) as validStartDate, max(valid_end_date) as validEndDate FROM b_marketing_data_valid_config WHERE is_del = 1 AND valid_type = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{offsetDay,jdbcType=INTEGER} DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') between valid_start_date and valid_end_date AND (user_type, api_code) IN (SELECT user_type , api_code FROM b_marketing_data_valid_config WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT});
